name: MxlChievements-Reforged
title: MxlChievements (Reforged)
author: FactorioParanoidal; based on MxlChievements by Mxlppxl and More Achievements by LuziferSenpai
description: Paranoidal achievements: the production achievements of MxlChievements 3.0.1 and More Achievements 0.0.2, plus achievements for the whole Paranoidal mod set — Angels and Bob, quality and defects, energy, trains and Factorissimo, Rampant and Big Monsters, space, challenges and scripted ones (deaths, distances, rockets, seasons, ruins). Achievements whose targets are missing in the active mod set are skipped; scripted tracking never stops the game.
